preparation.crs_wkt:
PROJCRS["NAD83(CSRS) / UTM zone 18N",
    BASEGEOGCRS["NAD83(CSRS)",
        DATUM["NAD83 Canadian Spatial Reference System",
            ELLIPSOID["GRS 1980",6378137,298.257222101,
                LENGTHUNIT["metre",1]]],
        PRIMEM["Greenwich",0,
            ANGLEUNIT["degree",0.0174532925199433]],
        ID["EPSG",4617]],
    CONVERSION["UTM zone 18N",
        METHOD["Transverse Mercator",
            ID["EPSG",9807]],
        PARAMETER["Latitude of natural origin",0,
            ANGLEUNIT["degree",0.0174532925199433],
            ID["EPSG",8801]],
        PARAMETER["Longitude of natural origin",-75,
            ANGLEUNIT["degree",0.0174532925199433],
            ID["EPSG",8802]],
        PARAMETER["Scale factor at natural origin",0.9996,
            SCALEUNIT["unity",1],
            ID["EPSG",8805]],
        PARAMETER["False easting",500000,
            LENGTHUNIT["metre",1],
            ID["EPSG",8806]],
        PARAMETER["False northing",0,
            LENGTHUNIT["metre",1],
            ID["EPSG",8807]]],
    CS[Cartesian,2],
        AXIS["(E)",east,
            ORDER[1],
            LENGTHUNIT["metre",1]],
        AXIS["(N)",north,
            ORDER[2],
            LENGTHUNIT["metre",1]],
    USAGE[
        SCOPE["Engineering survey, topographic mapping."],
        AREA["Canada between 78°W and 72°W, onshore and offshore south of 84°N - Nunavut, Ontario and Quebec."],
        BBOX[43.63,-78,84,-72]],
    ID["EPSG",2959]]
preparation.repair_provenance: Preserve XYZ precision and valid return labels; drop invalid legacy returns, duplicate XYZ (first row); then retain lowest-Z class-2 ground point per XY (first-row tie), audit removals; then repeated pulse/return (highest Z, first-row tie); raise NumberOfReturns to the pulse maximum reported count/return label. Pulse key: PointSourceID + gpstime (+ ScannerChannel if present). Do not infer pulse size from tile point counts; refuse remaining QC issues.

parameters.source_filter: -drop_synthetic before R decoding; audit counts; row IDs refer to filtered input
parameters.repair: Preserve XYZ precision and valid return labels; drop invalid legacy returns, duplicate XYZ (first row); then retain lowest-Z class-2 ground point per XY (first-row tie), audit removals; then repeated pulse/return (highest Z, first-row tie); raise NumberOfReturns to the pulse maximum reported count/return label. Pulse key: PointSourceID + gpstime (+ ScannerChannel if present). Do not infer pulse size from tile point counts; refuse remaining QC issues.
parameters.density: round(target * repaired source area); sample without replacement or add copies
parameters.synthetic: Seeded XY jitter uniformly within +/-0.25 m, quantized on source grid; reject collisions/outside source bounds; Z noise +/-seq(0.10,0.50,0.05) m; separate GPS-time ranges per copy; classifications/flags retained; synthetic derivation explicitly labeled in preparation metadata, not acquisition data.
parameters.readiness: Data QC only; cross-tool benchmark acceptance requires a new pilot.
parameters.negative_z: Drop Z < 0 before all other repairs; audit filtered-input row IDs and original Z.
